candidates.description: In rank order; empty when no hint would be issued.

rank.description: 1 is the closest; ranked by detourM, then taskId.

taskType.description: A task type an interleaving hint may point at.
taskType.title: TaskType

location.description: The location the operator must go to first.

detourM.description: Rectilinear detour in metres, rounded to 0.1 m.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, an invalid policy value, or an invalid path or query parameter.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or unknown field

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Site id is invalid
value.detail: siteId must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Station id is invalid
value.detail: stationId must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Hint id is invalid
value.detail: hint id must start with hint- and have no whitespace, control characters or '/'

invalidTaskType.summary: Unknown or empty eligible task types

value.title: Eligible task types are invalid
value.detail: eligibleTaskTypes must be a non-empty subset of PICK, PACK, REBIN, SLAM, RELOCATE, REPLENISH

value.title: Cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a value returned by this API

value.title: State is invalid
value.detail: state must be one of Active, Consumed, Expired, Superseded

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

422.description:
The request is well-formed but cannot be simulated: `policy-not-declared`
(the site is inert), `origin-unknown` (the origin has no known geometry),
`station-position-unknown` (no `fromLocation` and no recorded position),
or an `Idempotency-Key` reused with a different body
(`idempotency-key-reused`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

policyNotDeclared.summary: The site has no interleaving policy

value.title: The site has no interleaving policy
value.detail: declare a policy with PUT /sites/{siteId}/policy before simulating

originUnknown.summary: The origin has no known geometry

value.title: The origin location has no known geometry
value.detail: no geometry is known for location WH1-FWD-A01-01-01-A

stationPositionUnknown.summary: No fromLocation and no recorded position

value.title: The station position is unknown
value.detail: the station has no recorded position; send fromLocation

idempotencyKeyReused.summary: The key was used with a different body

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different request body
